The AQ4 coordinate records come from [1M17](https://www.rcsb.org/structure/1M17),
chain A, residue 999. The component tables are extracts of the wwPDB Chemical
Component Dictionary entries [AQ4](https://www.rcsb.org/ligand/AQ4),
[LAC](https://www.rcsb.org/ligand/LAC) and [FUM](https://www.rcsb.org/ligand/FUM).
They preserve named atoms, bonds, charges and stereochemistry. LAC and FUM
also retain their ideal coordinates for testing a pose and its opposite.
